create_pipeline_litellm_manifold: create a LiteLLM manifold pipeline that discovers and routes to multiple chat completion models
build_get_litellm_models: build a function that fetches available models from a LiteLLM server and returns their ids and names
run_pipe_chat_completion: run the pipe method to send a chat completion request to LiteLLM with streaming or non-streaming response
test_Valves_config: test the Valves pydantic model for configuring LiteLLM base URL, API key, and debug settings
review_on_valves_updated: review the on_valves_updated callback that re-fetches models when pipeline valves are updated
